<structure>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<description>
		A <page>table</page> structure containing the information of 3D skybox.

		Returned by <page>game.Get3DSkyboxInfo</page>.
	</description>
	<fields>
		<item name="origin" type="Vector">
			Position of the [sky_camera](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Sky_camera) entity.
		</item>
		<item name="scale" type="number">
			Scale of the 3D skybox.
		</item>
	</fields>
</structure>
